hook.name: OreToll
hook.description: OreToll charges a flat 1% fee on the ETH leg of all swaps in a single owner-pinned pool, collected via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Fees accumulate as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager and can be withdrawn permissionlessly to an owner-configurable treasury address. The fee schedule has equal min and max (both 1%), making the rate constant.
